description: Evolution passée du trait de côte is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. These layers represent the past evolution of the coastline of the beaches calculated on the basis of: rib lines available after 1950; rib lines available after 1980; rib lines available after 2000; rib lines available after 2010; of all available rib lines. Coverage: Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. The portal shows the English title as "Past evolution of the coastline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. Its keywords include erosion, trait-de-cote, evolution, accretion, monlittoral. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JPEG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
